title: Do All Cells Have a Nucleus? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
A one room hut and a college building with many rooms. Aarav asks: is a cell built like the hut or like the building, and does every cell have a nucleus?

You will see what every cell shares, zoom from the four shapes of bacteria into one bacterium and its naked DNA and plasmids, then build a eukaryotic cell step by step. Then prokaryotic vs eukaryotic side by side, plant cell vs animal cell, the organelles of a eukaryotic cell, a pause and think check, a worked example sorting three cells, the exam trap, an original NEET pattern statement question and a recap card.

This is Episode 61 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.

In this video:
0:00 A hut or a building?
0:40 What every cell has
0:57 Zoom in: bacteria to naked DNA
1:45 The eukaryotic cell, step by step
2:24 Prokaryotic vs eukaryotic
2:55 Plant cell vs animal cell
3:17 Organelles + pause and think
3:50 Worked example: sort three cells
4:17 Exam trap: do prokaryotes have DNA?
4:37 Practice question (NEET pattern)
5:06 Recap and three questions

Next episode: The Prokaryotic Cell: Envelope, Mesosome and Ribosomes. A bacterium has no bones and no shell, so what keeps it from bursting?
